description: This file defines the BasketItem class, an entity in the BasketAggregate of the application core, representing individual items in a shopping basket with properties and methods to manipulate quantities.

classes.name: BasketItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the shopping basket with properties for price, quantity, and identifiers, and methods to modify quantities with validation.

methods.name: BasketItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing a BasketItem with specified catalog item ID, quantity, and unit price.

methods.name: AddQuantity
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity to the existing item quantity after validation.

methods.name: SetQuantity
methods.description: Sets the item quantity to a specified value after validation.
